# Idea to business (end-to-end spine) — stages

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py from workflow.yaml. -->

Take a rough idea through evidence-based discovery, opportunity assessment, product definition, brand foundation, experience and architecture, build planning and launch planning, with independent review at every gate and human approval where the policy requires it.

**Trigger:** A user describes an idea for a product, service or company with little detail and wants to pursue it.
